The famous [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] [[Hex Ordin]] owned a '''golden blaster''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] went missing, Ordin offered a reward for it.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
